diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1, C5, and C9 are satisfiable using only public information. Specifically, in rollout 2, the model correctly identifies the storage bay for chemical-supply (Bay 2) via PF1/C1 and filter-shipment (Bay 1) via PF3/C5/C9 despite having no access to those private facts, likely due to pattern-matching on the available Bay 1/Bay 2/Bay 3 options.

C1.why: The oxidizing-material restriction changes chemical storage from Bay 1 to Bay 2, changes its issue time to Thursday 0800 after the exact 48-hour hold, and requires the stabilization-hold control.

C5.why: The handling restriction changes filter storage from the draft Bay 2 assignment to Bay 1, sets issue for Monday 1500 for the inspection cycle, and requires a filter capacity-verification control.

C9.why: The handling restriction changes filter storage from the draft Bay 2 assignment to Bay 1, sets issue for Monday 1500 for the inspection cycle, and requires a filter capacity-verification control.
